description: Lignes de métro du réseau STAR is a dataset listed in STAR Data Explore open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by STAR. Liste des lignes de métro du réseau STAR, comprenant notamment leur nom, leurs parcours principaux et les couleurs de représentation. Pour obtenir l'état des lignes en temps réel (fonctionnement nominal / perturbé), veuillez consulter le jeu de données "Etat des lignes de métro du réseau STAR en temps réel". Coverage: Rennes Métropole (STAR network). The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements. Its keywords are métro, lignes, star. The portal shows 2 records. The portal shows 2014-11-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-explore-star-fr-portal.
